Initial release of crypto-limit-order: decentralized, gasless, oracle-protected crypto limit orders across 8 EVM chains.

- Enables non-custodial spot limit order creation, signing, and submission on 8 EVM-compatible chains
- Provides authoritative relay endpoints and per-chain adapter addresses
- Includes full parameter normalization, typed-data payload generation, approval/signature instructions, and lifecycle management guidance
- Relies on local, instruction-based workflow; no automatic code execution or external calls
- Features detailed references and guardrails for agent behavior and order execution
